annotations.title: mlpeek: classify text into your own labels (zero-shot)

description: mlpeek: Classify a text into 1-10 of your labels. For named entities use extract_entities. Returns scores of 1-10 caller-supplied labels for an English text with the nli-deberta-v3-xsmall NLI cross-encoder (Apache-2.0): single-label scores sum to 1 (softmax over the labels), `multi_label` scores each label on its own; sorted best first. Scores are model confidences, not calibrated probabilities. English only. Runs an open model pinned by hash on Tanod's own CPU (no LLM, no third-party API); an unavailable model is a 503 (not charged). Typically 0.1-0.2 s for a short text and 5 labels, up to about 5 s at 10 labels. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 5 mlpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/named-entity-recognition-zero-shot-classification-api.html

labels.description: 1-10 unique candidate labels, each at most 100 characters.
